_doc: Investment-cost model for manufacturing_iot. Unlike every other vertical, config/playbooks/manufacturing_iot.json does not exist in this codebase (verified 2026-09-07 by direct search: no manufacturing_iot playbook file, and zero references to a manufacturing_iot playbook anywhere in backend/) — playbooks.definitions.load_vertical('manufacturing_iot') returns an empty playbooks list per its own documented 'no file -> no playbooks' behavior (backend/playbooks/definitions.py). This file therefore has zero playbook-level cost figures and every pillar is not_covered — a real, verified absence of playbook config for this vertical, not an authoring gap. csm_hourly_cost is still populated (a vertical-level labor-cost assumption independent of whether playbooks exist yet) so this file is forward-compatible the moment playbooks are authored for manufacturing_iot. Companion to config/economics/manufacturing_iot.json. Same {value, basis} discipline as config/investment/saas_premium.json.

csm_hourly_cost.basis: assumed: blended fully-loaded CSM/CS-ops hourly cost, same figure as every other vertical's file — CSM cost doesn't vary by vertical the way retention sensitivity does (config/investment/saas_premium.json's own basis sentence).

_playbooks_doc: Empty by construction: no config/playbooks/manufacturing_iot.json exists in this codebase as of 2026-09-07.
